fullPassage: Klara is an AF (Artificial Friend), a companion robot for children. She is solar-powered. She stays healthy when she gets the Sun's nourishment but feels weak and lifeless without sunlight. At the robot store, she enjoyed taking in the outside world from the windows. Klara closely observed what she saw, hoping to learn everything necessary to be a caring and helpful AF. One evening, she discovered that a homeless man was lying on the street without moving. Klara was sad as she believed he had died. But the next morning when the Sun was shining, she was surprised to see that the homeless man was sitting up and stroking his dog. Klara believed the Sun had saved him and came to have strong faith in the Sun's power to restore everything. One day, a fourteen-year-old girl named Josie visited the shop with her mother, Chrissie. Josie chatted with Klara joyfully. Josie immediately took a liking to Klara and asked whether Klara wanted to be her friend. Josie: I really want you to come to my home. I think you'll like my room, and we'll see the beautiful sunset from the windows there. We can do all the great things together all the time while I'm growing up. You want to come, right? Klara: (nodding hopefully) Josie: That's so good, but I want to be honest with you. I know how bad you'll feel after people promise you perfect things and they turn out not to be so. Some days I'm not so healthy or happy. I do not know why. Do you still want to come, Klara? Klara: If there's anything difficult or scary, we will face it together. To show that she would do her best to be Josie's friend, Klara held her hands together and shook them slightly. Pleased by Klara's gesture of friendship, Josie asked Chrissie for her permission to buy the AF. Chrissie asked Klara what she had observed about Josie, and found Klara to be highly observant. After requesting that Klara continue to care about Josie, Chrissie agreed to buy Klara and took her home. In Josie's country home, Klara found out that Josie had gone through a procedure known as "lifting." By being lifted, Josie's cognitive abilities had been genetically enhanced so that she had a better chance of getting into prestigious universities. However, Josie was suffering from serious side effects similar to those that had claimed the life of her sister, Sal. A mysterious chronic illness often caused her to stay in bed for days on end. Because of this, Josie spent most of her time at home and was being educated there. One day when Josie felt better, her mother took her and Klara to the city so that Josie could have her portrait done by Mr. Capaldi. In Capaldi's studio, Klara was asked to answer a questionnaire about Josie. Looking around the studio after completing the questionnaire, Klara entered Capaldi's office. To her surprise, she saw something that looked like Josie suspended in the air — it was an AF replica of Josie's body! As it turned out, Mr. Capaldi was not a painter but a scientist, who planned with Chrissie to transfer Klara's consciousness to the replica and make a new Josie if the real Josie were to die. Capaldi: Klara, tell me what you think about the replica. Klara: It resembles Josie quite accurately. Mr. Capaldi, you have done a good job of capturing Josie's appearance. I now understand why Chrissie asked me, at every step, to observe and learn Josie. The survey seems to test how well I have come to know Josie and how well I understand her decisions and feelings. Capaldi: We will ask you to become her and to live in that replica of Josie with everything you have learned. Learn Josie, not just superficially, but deeply, entirely. You have to continue her for Chrissie and for everyone else who loves Josie. Chrissie: I have doubts. I'm still not sure if this whole plan is the best thing we can do. I have been afraid of losing Josie ever since I lost Sal. That is why I agreed with you on this replica, but however well you make it, I don't think I will be able to accept this AF as my Josie. Capaldi: You must not lose faith, Chrissie. The survey Klara has successfully completed is clear evidence that she is already well on her way to understanding all of Josie's drives and desires. You believe that there is something unreachable inside each of us, something that is unique and won't transfer. But there is nothing like that. The new Josie won't be an imitation. She will be the exact same person and you will have every right to love her just as you love Josie now. Chrissie: But will I believe in it? When the day comes, will I really? Klara: Excuse me, but I would like to say there is a chance you will never need the new Josie. She may overcome her illness. If the day comes when you do need the new Josie, I will do my best to become as close to her as possible. However, it is wrong to give up hope already. Josie's health took a turn for the worse after she returned from the city. This made Klara determined to do everything she could for Josie. Klara remembered the barn into which the Sun had disappeared when she and Josie had been watching the sunset in Josie's room. Believing it to be the Sun's resting place, Klara visited there to pray to the Sun for Josie's recovery. Klara: You must be so tired, and I'm very sorry to disturb you, but I have come here this evening to ask a special favor. I have never forgotten how strong your power to restore everything is. Josie is becoming weaker and weaker each day. Please send Josie the special nourishment she so desperately requires as you did that day to the homeless man. The Sun was then sinking into the ground, but Klara could tell he was smiling at her as he went down for his nightly rest. Out of gratitude and respect, Klara continued to look at the Sun until his last light vanished into the ground. After several rainy days, the Sun came out to shine light on Josie and her whole bed. Josie woke up and made a miraculous recovery. Seasons and years went by, and she grew into a healthy adult. When Josie left for college, Klara was sent to the Yard, a place where old AFs spend their remaining days at the end of their lives. In the Yard, she remembered her days with Josie. Klara: Josie was the best teenager for me. I did all I could to learn Josie and to do what was best for her. If it had become necessary, I could have continued Josie. But I don't think it would have worked out so well. Not because I wouldn't have achieved accuracy, but however hard I tried, I believe now there would have remained something beyond my reach. Mr. Capaldi believed there was nothing special inside Josie, but I believe now that there was something very special. But it wasn't inside Josie. It was inside those who loved her. I would have never reached what they felt for Josie in their hearts. I am sure of this now.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① feel → feels: 주어 She(3인칭 단수)에 맞는 단수 동사 feels
det.analysis:
① feel → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'She stays healthy ~ but ___ weak and lifeless without sunlight'에서 주어는 She(3인칭 단수)예요. 앞의 stays와 and but으로 이어지는 병렬 동사이므로 단수형 feels로 써야 해요. feel로 쓰면 주어와 수가 안 맞아 틀려요. ❌ feel은 틀림 ←정답

② observed: 'Klara closely observed what she saw'에서 과거의 동작을 나타내는 과거시제 observed가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ discovered: 'she discovered that a homeless man was lying'에서 과거시제 discovered가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ stroking: 'the homeless man was sitting up and stroking his dog'에서 sitting과 and로 이어지는 병렬의 현재분사 stroking이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 3인칭 단수 주어 She → 단수 동사 feels

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ what had she observed → what she had observed: 간접의문문은 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」 어순
det.analysis:
① held: 'Klara held her hands together and shook them slightly'에서 과거시제 held가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② Pleased: 'Pleased by Klara's gesture of friendship, Josie asked'에서 '기뻐하며'라는 수동의 분사구문 Pleased가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ what had she observed → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'Chrissie asked Klara ___ about Josie'에서 asked의 목적어인 간접의문문이에요. 간접의문문은 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」의 평서문 어순이므로 what she had observed로 써야 해요. 의문문 어순 what had she observed처럼 도치하면 틀려요. ❌ what had she observed는 틀림 ←정답

④ found: 'and found Klara to be highly observant'에서 asked와 and로 이어지는 과거시제 found가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 간접의문문 = 의문사 + 주어 + 동사 (도치 안 함)

questions.passage: One day when Josie felt better, her mother took her and Klara to the city so that Josie ①<u>could</u> have her portrait ②<u>done</u> by Mr. Capaldi. To her surprise, she saw something that looked like Josie suspended in the air — it was an AF replica of Josie's body! As it turned out, Mr. Capaldi was not a painter but a scientist, who ③<u>planned</u> with Chrissie to transfer Klara's consciousness to the replica and make a new Josie if the real Josie ④<u>was</u> to die.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ was → were: 현재 사실의 반대를 가정하는 가정법이므로 if절에 were
det.analysis:
① could: 'so that Josie could have her portrait done'에서 '~할 수 있도록'이라는 목적의 so that절 조동사 could가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② done: 'have her portrait done by Mr. Capaldi'에서 'have + 목적어 + 과거분사(~이 …되게 하다)'의 사역 구문이라 done이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ planned: 'a scientist, who planned with Chrissie'에서 주격 관계대명사 who의 과거 동사 planned가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ was → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'if the real Josie ___ to die'는 일어날 가능성이 낮은 일을 가정하는 가정법이에요. 'if + 주어 + were to + 동사원형' 형태를 쓰므로 주어가 단수(Josie)라도 were로 써야 해요. was로 쓰면 틀려요. ❌ was는 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: 가정법 if ~ were to + 동사원형 (주어 단수라도 were)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ② appeared → disappeared: 태양이 헛간 속으로 '사라졌던(disappeared)' 것
det.analysis:
✅ ① determined: 조시를 위해 할 수 있는 모든 일을 하기로 '결심한(determined)' 것이라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ② appeared(나타났다) → disappeared(사라졌다): 'the barn into which the Sun had disappeared'에서 태양이 그 헛간 속으로 '사라졌던' 것이므로 disappeared가 맞다. 클라라가 그곳을 태양이 쉬는 곳이라 믿은 것과도 통한다. appeared는 정반대 ← 정답
✅ ③ pray: 조시의 회복을 위해 태양에게 '기도하러(pray)' 갔다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ④ recovery: 조시의 '회복(recovery)'을 위해 기도했다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: disappear into(~ 속으로 사라지다) ↔ appeared(나타났다)

questions.passage: Looking around the studio after completing the questionnaire, Klara ①<u>entered</u> Capaldi's office. To her surprise, she saw something that looked like Josie ②<u>suspended</u> in the air — it was an AF replica of Josie's body! As it turned out, Mr. Capaldi was not a painter but a ③<u>scientist</u>, who planned with Chrissie to transfer Klara's ④<u>clothing</u> to the replica and make a new Josie if the real Josie were to die. Capaldi: Klara, tell me what you think about the replica. Klara: It resembles Josie quite accurately.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ clothing → consciousness: 복제품에 옮기려 한 것은 클라라의 '의식(consciousness)'
det.analysis:
✅ ① entered: 클라라가 카팔디의 사무실에 '들어갔다(entered)'는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② suspended: 조시처럼 생긴 것이 공중에 '매달려(suspended)' 있었다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ scientist: 카팔디가 화가가 아니라 '과학자(scientist)'였다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ clothing(옷) → consciousness(의식): 'to transfer Klara's consciousness to the replica and make a new Josie'에서 복제품에 옮겨 새 조시를 만들려 한 것은 클라라의 '의식'이다. 옷(clothing)을 옮긴다는 것은 문맥상 부적절 ← 정답
det.tip: transfer one's consciousness(의식을 옮기다) ↔ clothing(옷)
